observations: Three overly high bay plinths and their front cap slabs were removed, along with nine unmatched protruding rectangular paving blocks. Fifteen selected connected components account for 666 removed triangles in eight original mesh buckets. Unselected original faces and their UVs remain unchanged after saving and reopening.

A closed shallow sediment bank now follows the observed left waterline. Its bottom is submerged, its top has genuine depth, and six major stone silhouettes were traced from the reference. The large dark straight retaining band and large random square blocks no longer dominate this area. Hidden bank depth and stone backs remain inferred.

Interior floors behind the three affected facade bays retain their prior 0.865 m elevation in separate closed rear slabs. Three square column footings and the chair landing were reshaped as chipped solids. Downward probes confirm all three column base centers remain supported and all four chair-leg endpoints meet the landing.

The first ground trial was too bright and formed conspicuous cones beneath previously floating plant roots. It was revised to lower, darker sediment. Thirteen existing plant groups were replanted by moving only the lower stem segments; leaf blades, grass tips, topology and pigments are preserved. Thirteen root-center probes and 126 individual grass-base probes meet the new surface within a few millimeters. Original instanced ivy is untouched.

The first oblique trial exposed triangulation stripes on the bank and a support gap under the lowest stair. Terrain height noise was reduced, upper terrain/soil faces use smooth normals, and a closed stone foundation now contacts the underside of the lowest stair. The final front, close oblique and full oblique renders were inspected after these corrections.

The reconstructed bank and rocks remain simpler than the source. Wet mottling, small cracks, moss fringes and the observed low railing are missing or approximate. Some old brown ground stubs remain visible in front of the bank, and neighboring unreconstructed lower-wall colors and geometry remain inconsistent. Vegetation is still darker and differently distributed in places. The prominent steel columns remain too uniform and bright.

56 closed reconstructed assemblies contain 10982 triangles and pass saved/reopened coordinate, manifold-edge, positive-volume and pigment checks. Movie and night scenes, all shared node groups, the rest of the poster geometry/materials/camera/lighting and all 23 packed images are preserved.

The actual Three.js construction chain was run in Node from v44 and v46 through v52. Twelve existing geometry buckets are replaced and thirteen exported buckets are installed. Positions, normals, UVs and colors match the native export; unaffected objects, all surviving original ivy matrices/colors and reusable materials are preserved. HTTP resources match local bytes. Browser/GPU rendering remains unverified; the latest actual browser connection attempt in v51 timed out.
